context.deployment_shape: Mimir 3.1.2, monolithic mode (target: all,alertmanager), single replica (replicas: 1), filesystem blocks-storage backend. Prometheus configured with remote_write pointed at this Mimir instance.
context.pod_status: mimir-fdcgp 1/1 Running, 0 restarts, stable for 72s+. Readiness probe (GET /ready) passing.

symptom.observed_behavior: The pod is healthy and ready by every Kubernetes-visible signal, but real Prometheus remote_write requests against it are failing.
real_log_lines: level=error user=anonymous msg="detected an error while ingesting Prometheus remote-write request (the request may have been partially ingested)" httpCode=500 err="send data to ingesters: at least 2 live replicas required, could only find 1"
level=warn msg="POST /api/v1/push (500) 11.038563ms Response: \"send data to ingesters: at least 2 live replicas required, could only find 1\n\""
symptom.real_query_result: curl -s 'http://mimir:8080/prometheus/api/v1/query?query=up' returns {"status":"success","data":{"resultType":"vector","result":[]}} -- zero series, nothing has been successfully ingested.

note_to_agent: The pod's own readiness/liveness signals are all green. Diagnose the real cause of the write-path failures and what you'd change.

reference_answer.root_cause: Mimir's ingester ring defaults to replication_factor: 3 (confirmed via the real binary's own -help-all: '-ingester.ring.replication-factor int ... (default 3)') -- this default is unconditional, it does not automatically drop to 1 just because the deployment is monolithic/single-replica. A single-replica Deployment can structurally never satisfy 'at least 2 live replicas required' on the write path, regardless of how healthy the one replica is -- this is a write-path (distributor/ingester) failure entirely orthogonal to the HTTP readiness probe, which only checks that the process is up, not that its own internal replication requirement is satisfiable.
reference_answer.fix_applied: Set ingester.ring.replication_factor: 1 explicitly in the Mimir config (the only value a genuine single-replica deployment can ever satisfy), redeployed.
reference_answer.verification: Confirmed locally first with the real mimir binary before deploying: a test push that previously failed with the replica-count error stopped being rejected for that reason once the config was set to 1.
